TO: Government Oversight 
  
DATE: Tuesday 4/22/2025 
  
TIME: 10:30 AM 
  
PLACE: Room 206 
  
AGENDA: 1. Welcome and Introductions 
  
 2. SB333 - Oklahoma Housing Authorities Act; modifying definition. 
Emergency. - Lawson, Haste* 
  
 3. SB403 - County purchasing; modifying duties of county purchasing 
agent related to bidders. Effective date. - Cantrell, Stewart* 
  
 4. SB405 - County officers; authorizing county commissioners to work 
with ambulance service districts for certain purpose. Effective date. - 
Cantrell, Alvord* 
  
 5. SB450 - State government; repealing certain task force. Effective date. - 
Roberts, Hines* 
  
 6. SB473 - Rural Economic Action Plan; requiring development of plan to 
measure certain qualitative effects. Effective date. - Roberts, Rader* 
  
 7. SB563 - County employee leave; authorizing board of county 
commissioners to develop certain leave policy; allowing county employees 
to use leave to serve as certain election officials. Effective date. - Staires, 
Haste* 
  
 8. SB646 - Judicial and federal official security and privacy; creating the 
Oklahoma Federal Official and Judicial Security and Privacy Act of 2025. 
Effective date. Emergency. - Hilbert, Paxton* 
  
 9. SB674 - Municipal zoning; allowing charter schools to submit certain 
charter school site plan. Effective date. - Caldwell (Chad), Pugh* 
  
 10. SB694 - Annexation and detachment; detachment of municipal 
territory; providing certain exceptions; allowing for certain written consent. 
Effective date. - Cantrell, Alvord*
